description: This Java class provides static utility methods to assist in building database query selection strings, such as generating equality clauses and concatenating multiple clauses with logical operators.

classes.name: DbQueryUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for constructing database query selection strings, including equality checks and clause concatenation.

methods.name: getEqualityClause
methods.description: Returns a SQL WHERE clause asserting the equality of a field to a value, optionally qualified with a table name.

methods.name: concatenateClausesWithAnd
methods.description: Concatenates multiple clauses with the 'AND' operator.

methods.name: concatenateClausesWithOr
methods.description: Concatenates multiple clauses with the 'OR' operator.

methods.name: concatenateClausesWithOperation
methods.description: Concatenates clauses using the specified logical operation ('AND' or 'OR').
